Use case: illustration-story. Production transparent NPC atlas for the existing warm hand-painted Sintra 2D RPG. Input is STYLE ONLY, do not duplicate its identities. Exactly FIVE equal columns and FOUR rows, twenty complete separate full-body sprites. Generous clear gutters and bottom margin.
Column 1: Alzira, tiny elderly Portuguese woman, silver bun, red glasses, plum cardigan, cream blouse, navy skirt, gossip notebook. Characteristic activity: observar a vila e lembrar os seus pequenos escândalos.
Column 2: Augusto, disheveled brown-skinned postman, curly hair, red postal jacket, beige trousers, leather mailbag, letters. Characteristic activity: entregar cartas em portas reais apesar de se perder sempre.
Column 3: Sven, tall pale blond tourist, green bucket hat, orange windbreaker, khaki shorts, enormous folded map. Characteristic activity: chegar à Pena sem voltar a confundir o palácio com a padaria.
Column 4: Dinis, thin olive-skinned man, unruly dark hair, blue suit jacket, mismatched brown and red shoes, parcel and wristwatch. Characteristic activity: correr para compromissos e deixar sempre alguma coisa para trás.
Column 5: Celso, stocky older Black municipal worker, gray beard, orange reflective vest, dark green overalls, broom and dustpan. Characteristic activity: cuidar das ruas e guardar os objetos que encontra.
Rows 1 and 2: two visibly different authored activity gestures appropriate to each individual, all props held close to body. Rows 3 and 4: the SAME five individuals walking to the RIGHT, two alternating arm/leg strides, carrying their own small props. Keep identical faces, hair, clothing, proportions and props in each column across all four rows. Friendly natural anatomy, textured gouache and pencil, warm subtle contours, neutral daylight exactly like the supplied style. Each complete person, shoes and hand props fit entirely inside cell; keep figures small enough for all four rows, especially bottom feet. No floor, scenery, text, logos, numbers, borders, watermark, extra people or background. TRUE alpha transparency, portrait composition.
